ledgerRows.admin_location: wp-admin -> Justice CRM -> Held Bituach Leumi lead triage / First paid-lead preflight
ledgerRows.required_evidence: At least 3 routable lawyer profiles exist for Bituach Leumi appeal work with routing enabled, accepted terms and billing/contact email.

ledgerRows.pass_condition: Justice CRM first paid-lead preflight shows coverage ready and no billing/contact blockers.
ledgerRows.blocked_until: 3 verified prospects are converted into routable lawyer profiles and billing/contact is present.
ledgerRows.allowed_next_action: Run one controlled consented lead drill.
ledgerRows.forbidden_action: Do not scale routing or claim supply readiness before the preflight is green.
ledgerRows.privacy_rule: Use internal record IDs in the live admin only, not in public reports.

ledgerRows.admin_location: wp-admin -> Justice CRM -> Held Bituach Leumi lead triage / First paid-lead preflight
ledgerRows.required_evidence: One lead has explicit_match_consent or owner_verified_consent, routing_hold cleared only by owner workflow, and Bituach Leumi appeal intent.
ledgerRows.crm_fields_or_anchors: consent_status=explicit_match_consent/owner_verified_consent; routing_hold cleared only after owner release; lead_revenue_model=qualified_appeal_lead
ledgerRows.pass_condition: The lead routes to an accepted specialist and creates qualified lead billing state.
ledgerRows.blocked_until: Client permission and owner release are recorded in the live CRM.
ledgerRows.allowed_next_action: Move the routed lead to billing queue after the handoff is actually made.
ledgerRows.forbidden_action: Do not infer consent from WhatsApp button click alone; do not send raw chat, screenshots, documents or contact details at preview stage.
ledgerRows.privacy_rule: No client name, phone, email, raw chat, exact address or documents in repo artifacts.

ledgerRows.admin_location: wp-admin -> Justice CRM -> Qualified lead billing queue
ledgerRows.required_evidence: Qualified lead billing status becomes ready_to_bill or invoice_sent with suggested lead price and linked billable lawyer.
ledgerRows.pass_condition: Manual invoice/payment request is sent to recorded billing contact and invoice/payment reference is saved before invoice_sent.
ledgerRows.blocked_until: The controlled lead is routed and the billing queue shows a billable lead.
ledgerRows.allowed_next_action: Send manual invoice/payment request and save reference.
ledgerRows.forbidden_action: Do not mark paid, claim revenue or automate payment collection without proof.
ledgerRows.privacy_rule: Repo report may record reference-present yes/no only, not invoice contents or private payment URLs.

ledgerRows.admin_location: wp-admin -> Justice CRM -> Qualified lead billing queue
ledgerRows.required_evidence: Payment proof exists through invoice/reference or private payment evidence URL and status is paid.
ledgerRows.crm_fields_or_anchors: qualified_lead_billing_status=paid; qualified_lead_invoice_reference present or qualified_lead_payment_evidence_url present
ledgerRows.pass_condition: Paid status has proof. The revenue loop can be counted once, with notes retained.
ledgerRows.blocked_until: Owner/admin must create or verify private prospects, activate routable lawyer profiles, run one consented controlled lead, then record invoice/payment proof.
ledgerRows.allowed_next_action: Record first paid-lead achievement and decide whether to scale the Bituach Leumi loop.
ledgerRows.forbidden_action: Do not count revenue if paid status lacks invoice/reference or evidence URL.
ledgerRows.privacy_rule: Keep payment proof URL private; do not copy receipts into repo.

ledgerRows.admin_location: Owner review after live CRM evidence exists

ledgerRows.allowed_next_action: If approved, repeat controlled batches; if not, fix terms/supply/consent first.
ledgerRows.forbidden_action: Do not expand WhatsApp/TalkTo lead routing or public claims before owner scale approval.
